grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Simple present of want: I / you / he, she
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'Do you want...?' about yourself and 'Does he/she want...?' about someone else. Answer with 'I do'/'I don't' or 'he/she does'/'doesn't', and use 'wants' (not 'want') after he or she.
grammarPoints.pattern: Do/Does + subject + want + a + noun? Yes/No, subject + do(es)(n't). He/She wants + a + noun.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Questions with this and these
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'Is this...?' about one thing close to you, and 'Are these...?' about more than one thing close to you. Answer with 'No, it isn't'/'Yes, it is' or 'No, they aren't'/'Yes, they are', then say whose it is by adding 's to the person's name.
grammarPoints.pattern: Is this + your + noun? No, it isn't. It's + name's + noun. / Are these + your + noun(s)? No, they aren't. They're + name's + noun(s).

intro_examples.jp: これらはあなたのパペットですか？いいえ、違います。それらはマークのパペットです。

japanese.rule: 近くにある1つのものには 'Is this...?'、近くにある2つ以上のものには 'Are these...?' と尋ねます。答えは 'No, it isn't'/'Yes, it is' または 'No, they aren't'/'Yes, they are' です。そのあと、名前に 's をつけて誰のものかを言います。
